reason: I'd use the free first visit for sure, and maybe come back once if my toddler loved it and I got some work done. But we'd only go once or twice a month, so I'm not paying for a membership.
objection: At $15 a visit it adds up on my budget, and I'd only go once or twice a month, so unlimited at $45 makes no sense for us. I'd rather pay for a visit now and then than commit.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper drop-in around $10, or a pack that doesn't expire so I can use it slowly.
